title: Fix FindDependencyCycles recursion crash risk (extend TSK-0321)
description:
## Source
Audit swarm finding F-AG5-21 (memorysmith-topicmap-exhaustive-audit-26-07-19-11-50-25)

## Problem
`FindDependencyCycles` in `MaintenanceAgentServices.cs` uses recursive `Visit` that carries the same uncatchable `StackOverflowException` crash risk as F56 (MaintenanceDiffService). TSK-0321 frames this as a performance concern but doesn't address the crash mode. `DependsOn` edges are confirmed reachable in production.

## Severity
High (crash risk)

## Files
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/MaintenanceAgentServices.cs` lines 1215-1253

## Recommendation
Add recursion-depth guard or rewrite as iterative DFS when implementing TSK-0321. Extend TSK-0321 scope to explicitly cover this crash mode.

## Existing Coverage
Extends TSK-0321 scope.
